## Planning

Brief or script in, shot list and prompts out.

### Shot Planner (Brief to Shots)

`ShotPlanner` · category **Shot Planner**

Turns a brief or script into a shot list with image and video prompts.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brief` | STRING | `A tired office worker finds a tiny dragon living in the o...` | The brief, script or idea in plain words. Product, place, people and mood all help the shots. |
| `provider` | choice: `offline` / `anthropic` / `openai` / `gemini` | `offline` | offline needs no key (template-based). Others call the LLM API. |
| `model` | STRING | `""` | Leave empty for the provider's default model. |
| `num_shots` | INT (1-30) | `6` | How many shots to plan. |
| `style` | STRING | `cinematic, photoreal, natural light` | Visual style written into every image prompt. |
| `aspect_ratio` | choice: `16:9` / `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `2.39:1` | `16:9` | Frame format, written into the prompts. Set your latent size to match. |
| `shot_seconds` | INT (1-20) | `5` | Target length of each shot in seconds (an LLM may vary it per shot). |
| `api_key` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional. Prefer the environment variable so the key is not saved in the workflow. |
| `extra_instructions` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Rules the LLM must follow, e.g. how the product or a character always looks. Ignored by the offline provider. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` | STRING | Full plan as JSON. Connect to Shot Selector to pick one shot. |
| `shot_count` | INT | Number of shots in the plan. |
| `image_prompts` | STRING (list) | List of image prompts. Downstream nodes run once per shot (batch). |
| `video_prompts` | STRING (list) | List of video prompts, one per shot. |
| `storyboard` | STRING | Readable storyboard text. |

### Shot Selector

`ShotSelector` · category **Shot Planner**

Outputs the prompts and duration for one shot.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner or Shot List Editor shot_list_json. |
| `shot_number` | INT (1-30) | `1` | 1 = first shot. Clamped to the last shot. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `image_prompt` | STRING | Image prompt of the shot. |
| `video_prompt` | STRING | Video prompt of the shot. |
| `duration` | INT | Duration in seconds. |
| `camera` | STRING | Camera move / framing note. |
| `description` | STRING | What happens in the shot. |

### Shot List Editor

`ShotListEditor` · category **Shot Planner**

Validates a hand-edited shot list so it can feed Shot Selector.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` | STRING | `{"title": "My film", "style": "cinematic", "shots": [{"id...` | A shot list as JSON: title, style and shots (id, description, camera, duration, image_prompt, video_prompt). Paste the planner's output here to tweak it. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` | STRING | The validated shot list, same format as Shot Planner's. |
| `shot_count` | INT | Number of shots. |

## Animatic

Keyframes or clips to a timed preview, no extra models.

### Shot Animatic (Keyframes to Video)

`ShotAnimatic` · category **Shot Planner**

Builds a timed animatic from keyframes, with push-ins, pans and tilts taken from each shot's camera note.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyframes` | IMAGE |  | One image per shot (connect the batch output of your sampler chain). |
| `fps` | INT (6-30) | `12` | Frame rate of the animatic. 12 is plenty for a preview. |
| `width` | INT (256-1920) | `960` | Output width in pixels; height follows the aspect ratio. |
| `aspect_ratio` | choice: `from keyframe` / `16:9` / `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `2.39:1` | `from keyframe` | Frame of the animatic. Keyframes are cropped to it. |
| `motion_strength` | FLOAT (0.0-0.5) | `0.12` | How far the camera moves (0 = still frames). |
| `crossfade_frames` | INT (0-24) | `4` | Frames each cut dissolves over (0 = hard cuts). |
| `default_seconds` | INT (1-20) | `3` | Used when no shot list is connected. |
| `shot_list_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | From Shot Planner: sets each shot's duration and camera move. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | All animatic frames as one batch (connect CreateVideo). |
| `frame_count` | INT | Number of frames. |
| `fps` | FLOAT | Frame rate (connect CreateVideo fps). |
| `timing` | STRING | Length and camera move of every shot. |

### Clip Stitcher

`ClipStitcher` · category **Shot Planner**

Concatenates one clip per shot, resized to match, trimmed to each shot's duration, with crossfades.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE |  | Frames from your video model. Runs once per shot when fed by Shot Planner lists. |
| `fps` | INT (6-60) | `16` | Frame rate of the clips (Wan = 16). |
| `crossfade_frames` | INT (0-24) | `4` | Frames each cut dissolves over (0 = hard cuts). |
| `trim_to_shot_duration` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Cut each clip to its shot's duration from the shot list. Shots without a duration keep their full clip. |
| `shot_list_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan, for the per-shot durations used by trimming. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | All clips joined as one batch. |
| `frame_count` | INT | Number of frames. |
| `fps` | FLOAT | Frame rate (connect CreateVideo fps). |

## Shot Critic and fixes

A vision LLM reviews the shots like an art director; the helper nodes route each shot to a re-render, a consistency edit or a local detail fix and keep only improvements.

### Shot Critic

`ShotCritic` · category **Shot Planner**

Reviews generated shots against the shot list and your rules, and rewrites prompts for the ones that fail.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE |  | One image per shot (the list from your sampler chain), or video clips. |
| `provider` | choice: `gemini` / `anthropic` / `openai` | `gemini` | Vision LLM that reviews the shots: gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY), anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) or openai (OPENAI_API_KEY). |
| `model` | STRING | `""` | Leave empty for the default (Gemini: Flash Lite, falls back to Flash if unavailable). |
| `pass_score` | INT (1-10) | `7` | Shots scoring below this fail and get a rewritten prompt. |
| `input_type` | choice: `images (one per shot)` / `video clips (one batch per shot)` | `images (one per shot)` | For clips, the start, middle and end frames are reviewed. |
| `checks` | STRING | `Anatomy: hands, fingers, limbs, eyes, faces (no extra or ...` | What the critic checks on every shot, one topic per line. |
| `brand_rules` | STRING | `""` | Anything that must be true, e.g. 'The cup logo reads NOVARA in white capitals'. |
| `candidates` | INT (1-8) | `3` | How many new versions to render for each shot that needs a re-render. Review them with a second Shot Critic and Shot Reroll Merge keeps the best. |
| `reviews` | INT (1-5) | `3` | Independent reviews run in parallel; each shot gets the majority verdict. Makes fast models (e.g. Gemini Flash Lite) much more reliable. |
| `seed` | INT (0-2147483647) | `1000` | Base seed for the re-renders (each candidate gets its own). |
| `shot_list_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | From Shot Planner: gives the critic each shot's intent. |
| `prompts` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Or connect the list of prompts used for the images. |
| `references` *(optional)* | IMAGE |  | Optional: product, logo or character references the shots must match. |
| `prior_verdicts_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Optional: verdicts of an earlier Shot Critic on the same shots. Its votes count again for shots that weren't re-rendered since, so one flaky review can't drop a real problem. |
| `api_key` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Prefer the environment variable (e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY). |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `report` | STRING | Readable review: score, issues (tagged detail or reroll) and new prompt per shot. |
| `contact_sheet` | IMAGE | All shots labeled PASS / DETAIL FIX / RE-RENDER. |
| `verdicts_json` | STRING | Machine-readable verdicts (connect to Shot Reroll Merge). |
| `reroll_prompts` | STRING (list) | Rewritten prompts for the shots that need a re-render, repeated once per candidate. Feed to a sampler. |
| `reroll_seeds` | INT (list) | One seed per re-render prompt (connect to the sampler's seed) so candidates differ. |
| `rerender_shots` | STRING | Numbers of the shots that need a re-render, e.g. '2, 5'. |
| `detail_shots` | STRING | Numbers of the shots that only need a local fix (logo, text, face, hands). |
| `detail_targets` | STRING | What the detail fixes should look for, e.g. 'logo, hand' (use as SAM 3 prompts). |
| `consistency_shots` | STRING | Numbers of the shots where a character or product doesn't match another shot. |

### Shot Reroll Merge

`ShotRerollMerge` · category **Shot Planner**

Replaces shots that needed a re-render with the best re-render. Skips the branch when nothing failed.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE |  | The original shots (same list the critic reviewed). |
| `verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Critic verdicts_json: says which shots to replace. |
| `route` | choice: `reroll` / `consistency` / `detail` | `reroll` | Which shots to replace: re-rendered ones, ones edited for consistency, or ones given a detail fix. |
| `rerolled` *(optional, lazy)* | IMAGE |  | Images rendered from reroll_prompts, in the same order. |
| `candidate_verdicts_json` *(optional, lazy, input only)* | STRING |  | Optional: verdicts_json of a second Shot Critic run on the re-renders. The highest-scoring candidate of each shot is kept. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE (list) | All shots in order, with the chosen route's shots replaced. |
| `summary` | STRING | Which shots were replaced, and by which candidate. |

### Shot Consistency Prep

`ShotConsistencyPrep` · category **Shot Planner**

Pairs every shot whose character or product drifted with the shot or reference that shows the correct look, plus the critic's edit instruction, for an image-edit model.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE |  | The shots the critic reviewed. |
| `verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Critic verdicts_json (consistency route and reference). |
| `references` *(optional)* | IMAGE |  | The same reference images given to the critic, if any. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `shots` | IMAGE (list) | The shots that need a consistency fix. |
| `references` | IMAGE (list) | For each of them, the shot or reference image that shows the correct look. |
| `instructions` | STRING (list) | The critic's edit instruction for each (Picture 1 = subject in the shot, Picture 2 = subject in the reference). |
| `targets` | STRING (list) | What to find in both images, e.g. 'woman' (use as SAM 3 prompt to crop the subject for a close-up edit). |
| `summary` | STRING | Which shot is fixed from which reference. |

### Shot Keep Better (never make it worse)

`ShotKeepBetter` · category **Shot Planner**

Never make it worse: keeps each fixed shot only if the critic scores it at least as well as the original (and no worse route).

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `before` | IMAGE |  | The shots before the fix (the list the first Shot Critic reviewed). |
| `before_verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | verdicts_json of the Shot Critic that reviewed 'before'. |
| `after` | IMAGE |  | The same shots after the fix (e.g. Shot Reroll Merge output). |
| `after_verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | verdicts_json of a second Shot Critic run on 'after'. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE (list) | Per shot, the fixed version if it scored at least as well, else the original. |
| `verdicts_json` | STRING | Verdicts matching the images that were kept. |
| `summary` | STRING | Which fixes were kept or rejected, with the scores. |

### Shot Continuity Prompts

`ShotContinuityPrompts` · category **Shot Planner**

Splits a shot list for consistency-first generation: shot 1 from text, every later shot edited from shot 1 so people, product and place stay the same.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner shot_list_json. |
| `continuity_note` | STRING | `Keep the same people (faces, hair, clothing), the same pr...` | Added to every later shot's prompt. Name the fixed details, e.g. 'the barista always wears a black top and black apron'. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `first_prompt` | STRING | Image prompt of shot 1, for the text-to-image model. |
| `next_prompts` | STRING (list) | Prompts of shots 2..N with the continuity note added, for the image-edit model (Picture 1 = shot 1). |
| `next_count` | INT | Number of later shots. |

### Shot Join

`ShotJoin` · category **Shot Planner**

Joins shot 1 and the later shots into one list of shots, all at shot 1's size.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first` | IMAGE |  | Shot 1 (only the first image is used). |
| `rest` | IMAGE |  | Shots 2..N, as a list or one batch. Resized to shot 1's size if needed. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE (list) | All shots as a list, one image per shot. |

### Shot Select (by route)

`ShotSelect` · category **Shot Planner**

Picks the shots a reviewer sent to one route, so a fix only touches those; put them back with Shot Reroll Merge set to the same route.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `images` | IMAGE |  | The shots (or clips) that were reviewed. |
| `verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Critic or Shot Video QA verdicts_json. |
| `route` | choice: `detail` / `consistency` / `reroll` | `detail` | Which shots to pick: those the reviewer sent to this route. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `shots` | IMAGE (list) | The picked shots, in shot order. When none match, shot 1 is passed as a placeholder (Shot Reroll Merge then skips the branch, so it never runs). |
| `targets` | STRING (list) | Per picked shot, what the detail fix should look for, e.g. 'logo, text' (SAM 3 prompt). |
| `summary` | STRING | Which shots were picked. |

## Video engine

One switch in front of the image-to-video stage.

### Shot Video Engine (switch)

`ShotVideoEngine` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Switch between image-to-video engines (local Wan, local MiniMax H3, or an API node). Only the chosen branch runs; the output is always one IMAGE clip per shot.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `engine` | choice: `local: Wan` / `local: MiniMax H3` / `api (VIDEO input)` | `local: Wan` | Which image-to-video branch to run. The other branches are skipped, so they cost nothing. |
| `wan_clips` *(optional, lazy)* | IMAGE |  | Clips from the local Wan branch (VAE Decode), one per shot. |
| `h3_clips` *(optional, lazy)* | IMAGE |  | Clips from the local MiniMax H3 branch, one per shot. |
| `api_videos` *(optional, lazy)* | VIDEO |  | VIDEO outputs of an API node (Kling, Seedance, Hailuo, Veo...), one per shot. |
| `fps_override` *(optional)* | FLOAT (0.0-120.0) | `0.0` | 0 = the engine's usual frame rate (Wan 16, H3 24, API from the file). Set it if your branch renders at another rate. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE (list) | One clip (IMAGE batch) per shot. |
| `source_fps` | FLOAT | Frame rate the clips were rendered at; use it to convert to the timeline's fps. |
| `summary` | STRING | Which engine ran and the clip lengths. |

## Video prompts

Per-shot motion prompts and frame counts for the chosen engine.

### Shot Motion Prompts

`ShotMotionPrompts` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Writes per-shot image-to-video prompts (subject action + camera vocabulary) and frame counts that suit the chosen engine.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan (or Shot List Editor). One motion prompt is written per shot from its description and camera field. |
| `engine` | choice: `wan2.1` / `wan2.2` / `minimax-h3` / `ltx` / `kling` / `seedance` / `hailuo` | `wan2.1` | Image-to-video engine. Sets the fps and the frame grid: Wan 4k+1 at 16 fps, MiniMax H3 17k+5 at 24 fps, LTX 8k+1 at 24 fps. API engines get the nearest allowed duration: Kling 5/10 s, Seedance 4-12 s, Hailuo 6/10 s. |
| `motion_strength` | choice: `subtle` / `natural` / `dynamic` | `natural` | subtle = slow, mostly still (product shots, faces); natural = realistic pace; dynamic = energetic action and faster camera. |
| `fps_override` | INT (0-120) | `0` | 0 = the engine's native fps. Set it if your workflow renders at another rate; frame counts are snapped to the grid at this fps. |
| `style_suffix` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Appended to every prompt, e.g. "cinematic, 35mm film grain, soft natural light". |
| `durations` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional seconds per shot, e.g. "3, 2.5, 4" (or Ad Beat Sync's durations). Overrides the shot list for the shots it covers. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `motion_prompts` | STRING (list) | One motion prompt per shot (list): subject action, pacing and camera move. |
| `frame_counts` | INT (list) | Frames per shot (list), snapped to the engine's grid; connect to the video node's length / num_frames. |
| `seconds` | FLOAT (list) | Seconds per shot (list) after snapping; for API engines this is the duration to request. |
| `negative_prompt` | STRING | Negative prompt for the engine (connect once; it is the same for every shot). |
| `fps` | INT | Frame rate of the engine (or fps_override). |

## Video QA and clip utilities

Offline (plus optional Gemini) clip checks, reroll merging and clip helpers.

### Shot Video QA

`ShotVideoQA` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Detects frozen clips, flicker, jumps/morphs, drift from the keyframe and melting regions, optionally asks Gemini, and routes shots to pass or reroll.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE |  | One clip (batch of frames) per shot, in shot order: the list output of your image-to-video node. |
| `keyframes` | IMAGE |  | The approved stills, one per shot (list, or one batch with one image per shot). Used for drift. |
| `checks` | STRING | `Product shape and label stay identical.\nNo extra fingers....` | Extra things the LLM reviewer must check, one per line. Ignored when use_llm is off. |
| `pass_score` | FLOAT (0.0-10.0) | `7.0` | Shots scoring below this (the lower of the offline and LLM scores) are routed to reroll. Frozen clips always reroll. |
| `use_llm` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Also send sampled frames to Gemini for a visual review (needs GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY). Off = offline metrics only. |
| `provider` | choice: `gemini` | `gemini` | LLM provider for the visual review. |
| `model` | STRING | `""` | Empty = gemini-flash-lite-latest, falling back to gemini-flash-latest when it is busy or replies badly. |
| `frames_per_clip` | INT (2-16) | `6` | Frames sampled evenly from each clip for the LLM and the contact sheet. |
| `seed` | INT (0-4294967295) | `0` | Base seed: the LLM call uses it, and every failed shot gets a new reroll seed derived from it and the shot number. |
| `brand_rules` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Brand rules for the reviewer, e.g. "logo never distorted; bottle always upright". |
| `motion_prompts` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Motion Prompts output. Given to the reviewer and used as the reroll prompt when it suggests no fix. |
| `api_key` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional Gemini key. Prefer the environment variable: a key typed here is saved inside the workflow. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `report` | STRING | Readable report: score, metrics and reasons per shot. |
| `contact_sheet` | IMAGE | One row per shot: sampled frames, a melting-region heat overlay and a PASS/REROLL label. |
| `verdicts_json` | STRING | Per-shot route (pass / reroll), score, reasons, metrics and reroll seed. Feed Clip Reroll Merge. |
| `reroll_shots` | STRING | Failed shot numbers, e.g. "2, 5" (empty when all passed). |
| `reroll_prompts` | STRING (list) | One motion prompt per failed shot (list): the reviewer's fix, or the original. |
| `reroll_seeds` | INT (list) | One new seed per failed shot (list). |

### Clip Reroll Merge

`ClipRerollMerge` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Replaces the clips Shot Video QA marked for reroll and passes the rest through; the reroll branch only runs when something failed.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE |  | The original clips, one per shot (same list that went into Shot Video QA). |
| `verdicts_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Video QA verdicts: says which shots failed. |
| `rerolled` *(optional, lazy)* | IMAGE |  | Re-generated clips for the failed shots only, in shot order (drive your video node with reroll_prompts / reroll_seeds). Lazy: not computed at all when every shot passed. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE (list) | All clips in shot order, failed ones replaced. Feed Clip Resample FPS or Ad Timeline. |
| `report` | STRING | Which shots were replaced. |

### Clips From Batch

`ClipsFromBatch` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Splits one batch into N clips by frame counts.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE |  | One batch holding all shots back to back (if several batches arrive they are joined first). |
| `frame_counts_text` | STRING | `""` | Frames per clip, e.g. "81, 49, 81". Must add up to the batch length. Empty = use frame_counts, else split equally. |
| `num_clips` | INT (1-256) | `1` | Used only when no frame counts are given: split into this many equal clips. |
| `frame_counts` *(optional, input only)* | INT |  | Shot Motion Prompts frame_counts (list). |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE (list) | One clip per shot (list). |

### Clip Last Frame

`ClipLastFrame` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Outputs the last frame of each clip, for chaining shots.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE |  | Clips, one per shot (list). |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `last_frames` | IMAGE (list) | The last frame of every clip (list of single images), e.g. as the start image of the next shot. |

### Clip Resample FPS

`ClipResampleFPS` · category **Shot Planner/Video**

Converts clips between frame rates (e.g. 16 fps Wan clips for a 24 fps timeline).

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE |  | Clips, one per shot (list). |
| `source_fps` | FLOAT (1.0-240.0) | `16.0` | Frame rate the clips were generated at (Wan = 16). |
| `target_fps` | FLOAT (1.0-240.0) | `24.0` | Frame rate of the timeline (Ad Timeline fps). |
| `method` | choice: `blend` / `nearest` | `blend` | blend = mix neighbouring frames (smooth); nearest = repeat/drop frames (sharp, slightly steppy). |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `clips` | IMAGE (list) | Resampled clips (list), round(frames x target / source) frames each. |
| `fps` | FLOAT | The target fps. |

## Ad assembly

Timeline, supers, end card, audio mix and an offline script.

### Ad Timeline

`AdTimeline` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Times each shot, conforms it to the aspect ratio (stills get a push-in, clips are trimmed or held) and joins them with transitions.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shots` | IMAGE |  | One image or one clip (a batch of frames) per shot, in order. Connect the list output of your image or image-to-video node. A single image becomes a still with a gentle push-in. |
| `fps` | INT (1-120) | `24` | Frame rate of the finished spot. |
| `width` | INT (64-8192) | `1920` | Output width in pixels. Height follows the aspect ratio (use 1080 for a 1080x1920 9:16 spot). |
| `aspect_ratio` | choice: `16:9` / `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:5` | `16:9` | Every shot is center-cropped to this aspect ratio. |
| `transition` | choice: `cut` / `crossfade` / `dip-to-black` / `whip-pan blur` | `cut` | How shots join. crossfade and whip-pan blur overlap the shots around each cut; dip-to-black fades out and back in. The total length stays the sum of the shot durations. |
| `transition_frames` | INT (0-120) | `6` | Length of each transition in frames (ignored for cut). Clamped to the shortest shot. |
| `ken_burns` | FLOAT (0.0-0.5) | `0.06` | Push-in strength for stills: 0.06 = zoom from 100% to 106% over the shot. 0 = static still. |
| `shot_list_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan. Each shot's duration (seconds) is used. Shots without a duration get 3 s. |
| `durations` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional seconds per shot, e.g. "3, 2.5, 4". Overrides the shot list for the shots it covers. |
| `split_single_batch` *(optional)* | BOOLEAN | `false` | If only one IMAGE batch is connected, treat each image in it as its own still shot instead of as one clip. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | All frames of the spot as one batch. Feed Ad Supers, Ad End Card or CreateVideo. |
| `frame_count` | INT | Number of frames. |
| `fps` | FLOAT | Frame rate (for CreateVideo). |
| `timing_json` | STRING | Start/end of every shot in frames and seconds, for Ad Supers and the audio. |
| `total_seconds` | FLOAT | Length in seconds (connect to Ad Audio Mix total_seconds if there is no end card). |

### Ad Supers

`AdSupers` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Draws timed text supers (titles, claims, legal lines) with fades.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE |  | Frames from Ad Timeline. |
| `supers` | STRING | `1 \| Meet the new Novara\n4 \| Available now` | One super per line: "shot_number \| text" (needs timing_json) or "start_s-end_s \| text" (e.g. "2.5-5 \| Text"). Use \n for a line break; lines starting with # are ignored. |
| `font_size` | INT (8-400) | `56` | Text height in pixels. Long lines wrap to 84% of the width. |
| `position` | choice: `lower third` / `center` / `top` | `lower third` | lower third = above the bottom title-safe margin. |
| `style` | choice: `white with soft shadow` / `black box` / `outline` | `white with soft shadow` | White text with a soft drop shadow, white on a translucent black box, or white with a black outline. |
| `fade_in_frames` | INT (0-120) | `6` | Frames to fade each super in. |
| `fade_out_frames` | INT (0-120) | `6` | Frames to fade each super out. |
| `timing_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | From Ad Timeline. Needed for shot numbers; also supplies fps. |
| `fps` *(optional)* | FLOAT (1.0-120.0) | `24.0` | Only used when timing_json is not connected. |
| `text_color` *(optional)* | STRING | `#FFFFFF` | Text colour as hex, e.g. #FFFFFF. |
| `font_path` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional .ttf/.otf path for your brand font. Empty = DejaVu Sans / Arial / built-in fallback. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | Frames with the supers drawn on. |

### Ad End Card

`AdEndCard` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Renders a brand end card (logo, tagline, CTA) and appends it to the spot.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE |  | The spot so far (Ad Timeline or Ad Supers). The card uses the same size. |
| `tagline` | STRING | `Made for the way you move.` | Main line under the logo. Empty = none. |
| `cta` | STRING | `novara.it` | Call to action / URL, drawn smaller under the tagline. |
| `background` | choice: `blurred last frame` / `solid color` | `blurred last frame` | Blurred and darkened last frame of the spot, or a solid colour. |
| `bg_color` | STRING | `#111111` | Background colour (hex) for solid color mode. |
| `duration_s` | FLOAT (0.1-30.0) | `3.0` | How long the end card stays on screen, in seconds. |
| `fps` | FLOAT (1.0-120.0) | `24.0` | Frame rate of the spot (connect Ad Timeline fps). |
| `logo_scale` | FLOAT (0.02-0.9) | `0.3` | Logo height as a fraction of the frame height. |
| `fade_in_frames` | INT (0-240) | `12` | Frames to cross-fade from the last shot into the card (part of the card's duration). |
| `logo` *(optional)* | IMAGE |  | Brand logo (first image of the batch is used). |
| `logo_mask` *(optional)* | MASK |  | Transparency for the logo, e.g. the MASK from Load Image (1 = transparent). |
| `invert_mask` *(optional)* | BOOLEAN | `false` | Turn on if your mask is 1 where the logo is visible. |
| `text_color` *(optional)* | STRING | `#FFFFFF` | Tagline / CTA colour as hex. |
| `blur_radius` *(optional)* | FLOAT (0.0-200.0) | `24.0` | Blur radius in pixels for the blurred last frame background. |
| `font_path` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional .ttf/.otf path for your brand font. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | Spot plus end card. Feed CreateVideo. |
| `frame_count` | INT | Total number of frames. |
| `total_seconds` | FLOAT | Total length in seconds: connect to Ad Audio Mix total_seconds. |

### Ad Audio Mix

`AdAudioMix` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Mixes voiceover, music (ducked under the voice) and SFX to the spot length.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `total_seconds` | FLOAT (0.1-600.0) | `15.0` | Length of the mix. Connect total_seconds from Ad End Card (or Ad Timeline) so audio and picture match exactly. |
| `vo_start_s` | FLOAT (0.0-600.0) | `0.5` | When the voiceover starts, in seconds. |
| `music_volume_db` | FLOAT (-60.0-12.0) | `-14.0` | Music bed level in dB (before ducking). |
| `duck_db` | FLOAT (-40.0-0.0) | `-10.0` | Extra music reduction while the voiceover is speaking (detected from its RMS level). 0 = no ducking. |
| `fade_out_s` | FLOAT (0.0-30.0) | `1.0` | Fade the whole mix out over the last N seconds. |
| `sample_rate` | INT (8000-192000) | `48000` | Output sample rate. Inputs are resampled; output is stereo. |
| `voiceover` *(optional)* | AUDIO |  | Voiceover (e.g. from a TTS node or Load Audio). |
| `music` *(optional)* | AUDIO |  | Music bed. Starts at 0 s; padded with silence or trimmed to the spot length. |
| `sfx` *(optional)* | AUDIO |  | Sound effects / ambience track. |
| `vo_volume_db` *(optional)* | FLOAT (-40.0-12.0) | `0.0` | Voiceover gain in dB. |
| `sfx_volume_db` *(optional)* | FLOAT (-40.0-12.0) | `0.0` | SFX gain in dB. |
| `sfx_start_s` *(optional)* | FLOAT (0.0-600.0) | `0.0` | When the SFX track starts, in seconds. |
| `attack_ms` *(optional)* | FLOAT (5.0-2000.0) | `150.0` | How fast the music dips when speech starts (it also starts this early, so the dip is in place for the first word). |
| `release_ms` *(optional)* | FLOAT (5.0-5000.0) | `150.0` | How fast the music comes back after speech. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `audio` | AUDIO | Stereo mix, exactly total_seconds long, peaks soft-limited to -1 dBFS. Connect to CreateVideo audio. |

### Ad Script From Shots

`AdScriptFromShots` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Template (offline) voiceover and supers that fit the shot timing.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shot_list_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan; each shot's duration sets its word budget. |
| `brand` | STRING | `Novara` | Brand name, said on the last shot. |
| `tagline` | STRING | `Made for the way you move.` | Tagline, said on the last shot and used as its super. |
| `words_per_second` | FLOAT (1.0-4.0) | `2.5` | Speaking rate used to fit each line to its shot (2.5 = relaxed commercial read). |
| `supers_mode` | choice: `first and last` / `every shot` | `first and last` | Which shots get a super in supers_text. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `voiceover_text` | STRING | One VO line per shot, each short enough for its shot. Feed a TTS node. |
| `supers_text` | STRING | Supers in "shot_number \| text" format for Ad Supers. |

## Voiceover

Text-to-speech placed on the edit, and fitting it to the shots.

### Ad Voiceover (TTS)

`AdVoiceover` · category **Shot Planner/Audio**

Text-to-speech voiceover (Gemini, OpenAI or ElevenLabs), placed per shot.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | STRING | `1 \| Every morning starts somewhere.\n3 \| Novara. Made for ...` | Voiceover script. Either "shot_number \| line" per line, one line per shot (Ad Script From Shots' voiceover_text), or plain text read in one go. Lines starting with # are ignored. |
| `provider` | choice: `gemini` / `openai` / `elevenlabs` | `gemini` | gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY), openai (OPENAI_API_KEY) or elevenlabs (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY). |
| `voice` | STRING | `""` | Empty = Kore (gemini), coral (openai), Rachel 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM (elevenlabs; use a voice ID). |
| `model` | STRING | `""` | Empty = gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts, gpt-4o-mini-tts or eleven_multilingual_v2. |
| `style_prompt` | STRING | `warm, unhurried, confident` | How to read it, e.g. "warm, unhurried Italian-accented English". Sent as the reading instruction to Gemini and OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini-tts); ElevenLabs ignores it (pick the voice instead). |
| `speed` | FLOAT (0.5-2.0) | `1.0` | Speaking rate. Native for OpenAI (0.25-4) and ElevenLabs (0.7-1.2); Gemini gets it as a pacing instruction. |
| `timing_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Ad Timeline timing. With per-shot lines, each line is synthesised separately and starts at its shot's start + line_offset_s, so the VO follows the edit. |
| `text_mode` *(optional)* | choice: `auto` / `numbered lines` / `one line per shot` / `plain text` | `auto` | auto: numbered if every line has "N \|", one line per shot if the line count matches timing_json, else plain text. |
| `line_offset_s` *(optional)* | FLOAT (0.0-5.0) | `0.3` | Delay of each line after its shot starts. |
| `trim_silence` *(optional)* | BOOLEAN | `true` | Cut the silence TTS adds before and after each line, so lines start exactly where they are placed. |
| `api_key` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Optional key. Prefer the environment variable: a key typed here is saved inside the workflow. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `voiceover` | AUDIO | 48 kHz stereo voiceover. When placed on the timeline, set Ad Audio Mix vo_start_s to 0. |
| `vo_timing_json` | STRING | Start/end of every line (and its shot), for Ad Voice Fit. |

### Ad Voice Fit

`AdVoiceFit` · category **Shot Planner/Audio**

Time-stretches voiceover lines that run past the end of their shot.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voiceover` | AUDIO |  | Ad Voiceover output. |
| `vo_timing_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Ad Voiceover vo_timing_json (where each line sits). |
| `timing_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Ad Timeline timing (where each shot ends). |
| `max_stretch` | FLOAT (0.0-0.5) | `0.12` | Most a line may be sped up: 0.12 = up to 12% faster (pitch is kept, WSOLA). Lines that still overrun are reported. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `voiceover` | AUDIO | Voiceover with overrunning lines tightened. Feed Ad Audio Mix. |
| `report` | STRING | Per line: fits / sped up by N% / OVERRUN by N s. |
| `vo_timing_json` | STRING | Updated line timing. |

## Beat sync

Shot durations that cut on the music's beat.

### Ad Beat Sync

`AdBeatSync` · category **Shot Planner/Audio**

Detects tempo and beats and picks shot durations that cut on the beat.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `music` | AUDIO |  | The music track (Load Audio). |
| `shot_count` | INT (1-100) | `6` | Number of shots to cut. |
| `target_total_s` | FLOAT (1.0-600.0) | `15.0` | Wanted length of the shots (without the end card). The result ends on the beat grid closest to this. |
| `min_shot_s` | FLOAT (0.1-30.0) | `1.5` | No shot shorter than this. |
| `beats_per_cut` | choice: `auto` / `1` / `2` / `4` / `8` | `auto` | Cuts fall every N beats from the first downbeat. auto picks the coarsest grid that still lets shot lengths vary. |
| `shot_list_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan: its durations are the preferred lengths (scaled to target_total_s). Without it all shots prefer equal length. |
| `fps` *(optional)* | FLOAT (1.0-120.0) | `24.0` | Timeline fps: durations are snapped to whole frames so cuts stay on the beat after Ad Timeline rounds them. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `durations` | STRING | Seconds per shot, e.g. "3.25, 2.5, ...". Connect to Ad Timeline durations (and Shot Motion Prompts durations). |
| `bpm` | FLOAT | Detected tempo. |
| `beat_times_json` | STRING | Beat times (original and aligned to the first downbeat), cut times and settings. |
| `music_offset_s` | FLOAT | Seconds to trim from the start of the music so the first downbeat lands on frame 0. |
| `music_aligned` | AUDIO | The music already trimmed by music_offset_s: feed Ad Audio Mix music. |
| `total_seconds` | FLOAT | Sum of the durations. |

## Social versions

Subject-following reframes and short cutdowns.

### Ad Reframe

`AdReframe` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Crops a spot to a social aspect ratio, following the subject smoothly.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE |  | The finished spot (or any clip). |
| `aspect_ratio` | choice: `9:16` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `16:9` | `9:16` | Target aspect ratio. The crop is the largest window of this ratio that fits in the frame. |
| `output_width` | INT (64-8192) | `1080` | Output width in pixels (1080 -> 1080x1920 for 9:16). |
| `smoothing` | FLOAT (0.0-1.0) | `0.6` | How calmly the crop follows the subject: 0 = follows every frame, 1 = one fixed crop at the average position. |
| `subject_mask` *(optional)* | MASK |  | Subject mask per frame (e.g. SAM video tracking). The crop centres on its centre of mass. Without it, a centre-weighted edge-energy saliency guess is used. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | Reframed frames. |

### Ad Cutdown

`AdCutdown` · category **Shot Planner/Ad**

Makes a 6 s / 15 s cutdown: picks and trims shots and keeps the end card.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE |  | The full spot including the end card (Ad End Card or Ad Supers output). |
| `timing_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Ad Timeline timing of the full spot. Frames after its last shot are the end card and are always kept. |
| `target_seconds` | FLOAT (1.0-120.0) | `6.0` | Length of the cutdown including the end card (6 = bumper, 15). |
| `keep` | STRING | `auto` | Shot numbers to keep, e.g. "1, 4, 6", or auto = first shot, best-scored middle shots, last shot. |
| `verdicts_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Video QA verdicts: their scores rank the middle shots in auto mode. |
| `min_shot_s` *(optional)* | FLOAT (0.2-10.0) | `1.5` | auto keeps only as many shots as fit at this length each. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `frames` | IMAGE | Cutdown frames (hard cuts), end card included. |
| `timing_json` | STRING | Timing of the kept shots (for Ad Supers / Ad Voiceover on the cutdown). |
| `frame_count` | INT | Number of frames. |
| `total_seconds` | FLOAT | Length in seconds including the end card: connect to Ad Audio Mix total_seconds. |
| `report` | STRING | Which shots were kept and how long it runs. |

Print-ready director's treatment, pitch deck, storyboard sheet and palette.

Lays out a director's treatment: cover, idea, mood board, palette, story at a glance, shot-by-shot pages, brand, production notes and closing page.

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |

| `logo_mask` *(optional)* | MASK |  | Logo transparency, e.g. the MASK from Load Image (1 = transparent). |

| `accent_hex` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Accent colour, e.g. #C8743A. Empty = picked from the keyframe palette. |

| `pdf_path` | STRING | Path of the PDF written to ComfyUI's output folder. |
| `pages` | IMAGE | Every page as an image, 1240 px wide (connect Preview Image). |
| `page_count` | INT | Number of pages. |

|---|---|---|

| `slides` | IMAGE | Every slide at full resolution. |
| `slide_count` | INT | Number of slides. |

### Storyboard Sheet

`StoryboardSheet` · category **Shot Planner/Treatment**

Storyboard sheet: numbered panels, camera arrows from the camera field (push-in = frame lines, pan = arrow, tilt = vertical arrow), captions.

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyframes` | IMAGE |  | Approved keyframes, one still per shot in shot order (after Shot Critic / Detail Fixer). A batch or a list; sizes may differ. |
| `shot_list_json` *(input only)* | STRING |  | Shot Planner plan: title, style and per-shot description, camera, duration. |
| `columns` | INT (1-8) | `4` | Panels per row. Rows follow from the paper; extra shots go onto further sheets. |
| `paper` | choice: `A4 landscape` / `A3` / `16:9` | `A4 landscape` | A4 landscape and A3 at 300 dpi; 16:9 at 3840 x 2160. |
| `save_pdf` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Also write a PDF to the output folder. |
| `filename_prefix` | STRING | `treatment/storyboard` | PDF name inside ComfyUI's output folder (subfolders allowed). |
| `timing_json` *(optional, input only)* | STRING |  | Ad Timeline timing: real in/out timecodes and the timeline ruler. Without it, shot list durations are used. |
| `brand` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Brand name; used as a wordmark when no logo is connected. |
| `date` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Date shown on the documents. Empty = today. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `sheet` | IMAGE | The storyboard sheet(s) at print resolution. |
| `pdf_path` | STRING | Path of the PDF, or empty when save_pdf is off. |

### Palette From Shots

`PaletteFromShots` · category **Shot Planner/Treatment**

Extracts a named colour palette from the keyframes (k-means in Lab).

Receives whole lists (one item per shot) and runs once.

**Inputs**

| Input | Type | Default | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyframes` | IMAGE |  | Approved keyframes, one still per shot in shot order (after Shot Critic / Detail Fixer). A batch or a list; sizes may differ. |
| `colors` | INT (1-12) | `6` | Maximum number of swatches (near-identical colours are merged, so you may get fewer). |
| `accent_hex` *(optional)* | STRING | `""` | Force an accent colour. Empty = the most colourful swatch that is present enough. |

**Outputs**

| Output | Type | Tooltip |
|---|---|---|
| `swatches` | IMAGE | Palette card image (1600 x 900). |
| `palette_json` | STRING | Swatches as JSON: hex, rgb, Lab, name and share of the picture. |
| `accent_hex` | STRING | Accent colour (connect to Treatment Builder / Pitch Deck Builder accent_hex). |
| `text_on_accent_hex` | STRING | Black or white text colour that passes WCAG AA on the accent. |
